item.title: Bahrain's military reports intercepting another Iranian aerial attack by 2 Dec 2026
item.summary: 85% chance Bahrain's military reports intercepting another Iranian aerial attack between this forecast's registration and 2 Dec 2026: Bahrain reported interceptions on 15 and 17 Nov, the IRGC claimed a third strike on 13 Nov (three in five days after a two-month lull), and UKMTO logged tanker attacks in the Gulf on 15 and 16 Nov.

alternatives.hypothesis: Iran pauses strikes on Bahrain (a lull like September to November, or a ceasefire)
alternatives.tell_apart: no Bahrain Defence Force or Bahrain News Agency interception statement and no IRGC claim on Bahrain through 2 Dec

alternatives.hypothesis: Attacks continue but only US forces report the interceptions
alternatives.tell_apart: CENTCOM statements on drones shot down over Bahrain with no Bahraini statement

resolution.rule: Yes if the Bahrain Defence Force or the Bahrain News Agency states that Bahrain's air defences intercepted an Iranian aerial attack (drone or missile) dated after this forecast's published_at and on or before 2 Dec 2026 (Bahrain time), or two of Reuters, AP and AFP report such a Bahraini statement. An interception reported only by US forces does not count. No otherwise.
resolution.source: Bahrain News Agency (bna.bh), Bahrain Defence Force statements, Reuters, AP, AFP
resolution.void_if: a Bahraini interception dated 18 Nov 2026 was reported before this forecast's published_at
